note: D6 is terminal and release-blocking. It creates no table and ships ONE migration, 0007, altering THREE constraints, which exists because of a defect rather than a feature: Enrollment.student_account_id is ondelete CASCADE while guardian_account_id is SET NULL, so a student deleting their account would destroy the teacher's attendance, marks and settled fee history for that seat, while a guardian doing the same loses nothing. Six foreign keys point at enrollment.id and all six CASCADE, verified by reading the model. Three human decisions on 2026-10-25 shape this unit: a teacher owning any batch cannot delete their account, because account -> owner -> batch -> enrollment -> six tables is the largest cascade in the product and nothing had considered it: hard-delete the account row, honouring the published policy over the manifest's ANONYMIZE_IN_PLACE; and fix the cascade by constraint rather than by deletion code. Two Deferred rows, each naming an obligation with no automated verifier or awaiting a human step. Zero GAP rows.
